name: Wild Card
description: Rule mod: N Wild Cards are shuffled into the deck (host sets the count in the lobby). A Wild Card in a declared bag automatically becomes the declared legal goods. Legal goods, never confiscated.
description_zh: 玩法模组：牌库中加入 n 张万能卡（房主在大厅设置数量）。申报时袋中的万能卡自动变成所申报的合法货物，属于合法品不会被没收。
